title: shop: uptime
description: The platform's outside-in HTTP checks of the project's public frontends and routes, and every forge.UptimeCheck: availability, incidents (3 failed probes in a row open one, the next passing probe closes it), probe time and certificate expiry. Hosted environments only.

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: The share of the range's probes that passed, over every check, and how many checks are down (an incident is open: 3 failed probes in a row, until one passes) or unknown (no probe in the last 15 minutes) at the end of the range.
panels.sql:
WITH history AS (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'] AS env_id, ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS env,
         Attributes['check'] AS check, TimeUnix AS ts, Value >= 1 AS up,
         if(Attributes['error.type'] != '', Attributes['error.type'], concat('HTTP ', Attributes['http.response.status_code'])) AS error
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'uptime.check.up'
    AND TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND Attributes['check'] != ''),
last_pass AS (
  SELECT env_id, check, toNullable(max(ts)) AS at FROM history WHERE up AND ts < {from:DateTime64(9)} GROUP BY env_id, check),
probes AS (
  SELECT h.env_id AS env_id, h.env AS env, h.check AS check, h.ts AS ts, h.up AS up, h.error AS error,
         h.ts >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AS in_range
  FROM history AS h LEFT JOIN last_pass AS l ON l.env_id = h.env_id AND l.check = h.check
  WHERE l.at IS NULL OR h.ts >= l.at),
runs AS (
  SELECT *, sum(up) OVER (PARTITION BY env_id, check ORDER BY ts, up ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS passes
  FROM probes),
failure_runs AS (
  SELECT env_id, any(env) AS env, check, passes AS run, min(ts) AS started, count() AS failures,
         argMax(error, ts) AS last_error
  FROM runs WHERE NOT up GROUP BY env_id, check, passes),
closing AS (
  SELECT env_id, check, toUInt64(passes - 1) AS closes, toNullable(ts) AS ended FROM runs WHERE up),
incidents AS (
  SELECT f.env_id AS env_id, f.env AS env, f.check AS check, f.started AS started, c.ended AS ended,
         f.failures AS failures, f.last_error AS last_error
  FROM failure_runs AS f
  LEFT JOIN closing AS c ON c.env_id = f.env_id AND c.check = f.check AND c.closes = f.run
  WHERE f.failures >= 3 AND ifNull(c.ended, {to:DateTime64(9)}) > {from:DateTime64(9)}),
samples AS (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'] AS env_id, ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS env,
         Attributes['check'] AS check, MetricName AS metric, TimeUnix AS ts, Value AS value
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('uptime.check.up', 'uptime.check.duration', 'tls.cert.expiry_seconds')
    AND TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND Attributes['check'] != ''),
per_check AS (
  SELECT env_id, any(env) AS env, check,
         countIf(in_range) AS probes, countIf(in_range AND NOT up) AS failed,
         max(ts) AS last_probe
  FROM probes GROUP BY env_id, check),
per_incident AS (
  SELECT env_id, check, count() AS n, sum(greatest(0, dateDiff('second', greatest(started, {from:DateTime64(9)}), least(ifNull(ended, {to:DateTime64(9)}), {to:DateTime64(9)})))) AS downtime,
         minIf(started, ended IS NULL) AS open_since, countIf(ended IS NULL) > 0 AS open
  FROM incidents GROUP BY env_id, check),
per_timing AS (
  SELECT env_id, check,
         quantileExactIf(0.5)(value * 1000, metric = 'uptime.check.duration') AS p50,
         quantileExactIf(0.95)(value * 1000, metric = 'uptime.check.duration') AS p95,
         countIf(metric = 'uptime.check.duration') > 0 AS has_timing,
         argMaxIf(value, ts, metric = 'tls.cert.expiry_seconds') AS cert_seconds,
         countIf(metric = 'tls.cert.expiry_seconds') > 0 AS has_cert
  FROM samples GROUP BY env_id, check),
checks AS (
  SELECT c.env_id AS env_id, c.env AS env, c.check AS check,
         multiIf(c.last_probe < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE, 'unknown', ifNull(i.open, 0), 'down', 'up') AS state,
         c.probes AS probes, c.failed AS failed,
         if(c.probes = 0, NULL, (c.probes - c.failed) / c.probes) AS availability,
         ifNull(i.n, 0) AS incidents, ifNull(i.downtime, 0) AS downtime,
         if(ifNull(i.open, 0), i.open_since, NULL) AS down_since,
         if(t.has_timing, t.p50, NULL) AS p50, if(t.has_timing, t.p95, NULL) AS p95,
         if(t.has_cert, round(t.cert_seconds / 86400, 1), NULL) AS cert_days,
         c.last_probe AS last_probe
  FROM per_check AS c
  LEFT JOIN per_incident AS i ON i.env_id = c.env_id AND i.check = c.check
  LEFT JOIN per_timing AS t ON t.env_id = c.env_id AND t.check = c.check
  WHERE c.probes > 0 OR ifNull(i.n, 0) > 0)
SELECT if(sum(probes) = 0, NULL, round(sum(probes - failed) / sum(probes), 5)) AS "Availability",
       count() AS "Checks", countIf(state = 'down') AS "Checks down", countIf(state = 'unknown') AS "Checks unknown",
       sum(downtime) AS "Downtime"
FROM checks

panels.title: Checks over time
panels.description: Each check's share of passed probes in each bucket. An empty cell is a bucket with no probe: unknown, not up.
panels.sql:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'] AS env_id, ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS env,
         Attributes['check'] AS check, MetricName AS metric, TimeUnix AS ts, Value AS value
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('uptime.check.up', 'uptime.check.duration', 'tls.cert.expiry_seconds')
    AND TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND Attributes['check'] != '')
SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, toIntervalSecond({step:UInt32})) AS t, if(length({env_ids:Array(String)}) = 1, check, concat(check, ' (', env, ')')) AS "Check",
       round(countIf(value >= 1) / count(), 4) AS "Availability"
FROM samples
WHERE metric = 'uptime.check.up'
GROUP BY t, env, check ORDER BY t, "Check"

panels.title: Checks
panels.description: Per check: its status at the end of the range, availability (passed probes over probes), incidents and their downtime in the range, the open incident's start, the p50 and p95 probe time, and the days left on its TLS certificate.

WITH history AS (

  SELECT f.env_id AS env_id, f.env AS env, f.check AS check, f.started AS started, c.ended AS ended,
         f.failures AS failures, f.last_error AS last_error
  FROM failure_runs AS f
  LEFT JOIN closing AS c ON c.env_id = f.env_id AND c.check = f.check AND c.closes = f.run
  WHERE f.failures >= 3 AND ifNull(c.ended, {to:DateTime64(9)}) > {from:DateTime64(9)}),
samples AS (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'] AS env_id, ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS env,
         Attributes['check'] AS check, MetricName AS metric, TimeUnix AS ts, Value AS value
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('uptime.check.up', 'uptime.check.duration', 'tls.cert.expiry_seconds')
    AND TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND Attributes['check'] != ''),

  SELECT env_id, any(env) AS env, check,

  FROM probes GROUP BY env_id, check),
per_incident AS (
  SELECT env_id, check, count() AS n, sum(greatest(0, dateDiff('second', greatest(started, {from:DateTime64(9)}), least(ifNull(ended, {to:DateTime64(9)}), {to:DateTime64(9)})))) AS downtime,
         minIf(started, ended IS NULL) AS open_since, countIf(ended IS NULL) > 0 AS open
  FROM incidents GROUP BY env_id, check),
per_timing AS (
  SELECT env_id, check,
         quantileExactIf(0.5)(value * 1000, metric = 'uptime.check.duration') AS p50,
         quantileExactIf(0.95)(value * 1000, metric = 'uptime.check.duration') AS p95,

         countIf(metric = 'tls.cert.expiry_seconds') > 0 AS has_cert
  FROM samples GROUP BY env_id, check),

  SELECT c.env_id AS env_id, c.env AS env, c.check AS check,
         multiIf(c.last_probe < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE, 'unknown', ifNull(i.open, 0), 'down', 'up') AS state,
         c.probes AS probes, c.failed AS failed,
         if(c.probes = 0, NULL, (c.probes - c.failed) / c.probes) AS availability,
         ifNull(i.n, 0) AS incidents, ifNull(i.downtime, 0) AS downtime,
         if(ifNull(i.open, 0), i.open_since, NULL) AS down_since,
         if(t.has_timing, t.p50, NULL) AS p50, if(t.has_timing, t.p95, NULL) AS p95,

         c.last_probe AS last_probe
  FROM per_check AS c
  LEFT JOIN per_incident AS i ON i.env_id = c.env_id AND i.check = c.check

SELECT if(length({env_ids:Array(String)}) = 1, check, concat(check, ' (', env, ')')) AS "Check", c.state AS "Status",

       c.incidents AS "Incidents", c.downtime AS "Downtime",

panels.title: Incidents
panels.description: Every incident that reaches the range, newest first: when it started (perhaps before the range), when the next passing probe closed it (none while open), its duration, its failed probes and the last error.
panels.sql:
WITH history AS (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'] AS env_id, ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS env,
         Attributes['check'] AS check, TimeUnix AS ts, Value >= 1 AS up,
         if(Attributes['error.type'] != '', Attributes['error.type'], concat('HTTP ', Attributes['http.response.status_code'])) AS error
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'uptime.check.up'
    AND TimeUnix >= {from:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND TimeUnix < {to:DateTime64(9)}
    AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, ResourceAttributes['reliant.env.id'])) AND Attributes['check'] != ''),
last_pass AS (
  SELECT env_id, check, toNullable(max(ts)) AS at FROM history WHERE up AND ts < {from:DateTime64(9)} GROUP BY env_id, check),
probes AS (
  SELECT h.env_id AS env_id, h.env AS env, h.check AS check, h.ts AS ts, h.up AS up, h.error AS error,
         h.ts >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AS in_range
  FROM history AS h LEFT JOIN last_pass AS l ON l.env_id = h.env_id AND l.check = h.check
  WHERE l.at IS NULL OR h.ts >= l.at),
runs AS (
  SELECT *, sum(up) OVER (PARTITION BY env_id, check ORDER BY ts, up ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS passes
  FROM probes),
failure_runs AS (
  SELECT env_id, any(env) AS env, check, passes AS run, min(ts) AS started, count() AS failures,
         argMax(error, ts) AS last_error
  FROM runs WHERE NOT up GROUP BY env_id, check, passes),
closing AS (
  SELECT env_id, check, toUInt64(passes - 1) AS closes, toNullable(ts) AS ended FROM runs WHERE up),
incidents AS (
  SELECT f.env_id AS env_id, f.env AS env, f.check AS check, f.started AS started, c.ended AS ended,
         f.failures AS failures, f.last_error AS last_error
  FROM failure_runs AS f
  LEFT JOIN closing AS c ON c.env_id = f.env_id AND c.check = f.check AND c.closes = f.run
  WHERE f.failures >= 3 AND ifNull(c.ended, {to:DateTime64(9)}) > {from:DateTime64(9)})
SELECT if(length({env_ids:Array(String)}) = 1, check, concat(check, ' (', env, ')')) AS "Check", toDateTime(started, 'UTC') AS "Started",
       if(ended IS NULL, NULL, toDateTime(ended, 'UTC')) AS "Ended",
       dateDiff('second', started, ifNull(ended, {to:DateTime64(9)})) AS "Duration",
       failures AS "Failed probes", last_error AS "Last error"
FROM incidents
ORDER BY started DESC, "Check"
LIMIT 500
